what.en: Text: B. P. Abbott et al. (LIGO Scientific Collaboration and Virgo Collaboration), “Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger”, Phys. Rev. Lett. 116, 061102 (2016), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.116.061102. Abridged from the published letter (Sections IV and VII, parts of Sections I, III, V and VI and most of the acknowledgments cut; sections and references renumbered); figures redrawn; figure captions shortened. workarounds.note: a ::resource with placement { position: 'here', span: 'page' } in a 'double' layout is set one column wide: Figure 1 sits inside a callout whose style has span: 'page' (the plate box), which gives it the full measure

table cells and captions take no maths: each Table I value is a MathJax SVG drawn in its cell with TableCell.image, its width a fraction of the cell's inner width; captions keep to ^sup^ and ~sub~ and no Greek
